# Links

An [inline link](https://typst.app) opens this sentence, a [reference
link][commonmark] follows it, and an autolink closes it at
<https://github.com/>.

Write to <ivapo@example.com>, and the address reaches the PDF as a mailto
destination rather than as plain text.

A destination carries whatever CommonMark lets it carry, including the two
characters the markup escape would otherwise touch:
[a hostile URL](https://example.com/a"b#frag).

[commonmark]: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/
